decisions.reason: As a design-led decorative variant with uncertain evidence of continued prominence after launch, it is likely to be judged against aspiration levels as easier to replace with newer collection items than to carry further.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric fits the existing range but, if sales fell short of aspiration, boundedly rational management would likely reallocate shelf and sampling resources to fresher decorative lines.

Because it is close to the established decorative offer and therefore not resource-critical, management would be inclined to discontinue it if it did not clearly outperform internal and peer-based aspiration levels.

A velour-like upholstery fabric is closely tied to the firm’s core upholstery business, so with available warehouse and service capabilities the firm has reason to retain it unless performance is clearly weak.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric adds a functional specification that supports dependable supply and reorder continuity, making it more likely to be kept under moderate uncertainty.
As a complementary lining fabric that fits existing stocked and made-to-measure operations, it is likely to be retained unless margins or demand are noticeably below aspiration.
